synopsis.statement: A barebones WebSocket server and client implementation written in 100% Java, built on java.nio for a non-blocking event-driven model, implementing RFC 6455 and RFC 7692, and published on Maven Central as org.java-websocket:Java-WebSocket; a server or client by itself does nothing until your subclass of WebSocketServer or WebSocketClient adds purpose.

shape.tree:
├── .github/                                issue and PR templates plus CI, checkstyle and sonar workflows
├── autobahn reports/                       stored report pages for clients and servers
├── src/main/example/                       the examples the README points to - chat, SSL and wss, per-message deflate, proxy, reconnect, socket activation
├── src/main/java/org/java_websocket/       core connection classes (WebSocket, WebSocketImpl, SSL socket channels), java.nio based
│   ├── client/                             the WebSocketClient abstract class your subclass extends, plus DnsResolver
│   ├── drafts/                             Draft_6455, the RFC 6455 protocol implementation
│   ├── enums/                              opcode, ready state, role and handshake state values
│   ├── exceptions/                         websocket-specific exceptions (invalid frame, invalid handshake, limits)
│   ├── extensions/                         extension support, including permessage_deflate for RFC 7692
│   ├── framing/                            frame types - text, binary, ping, pong, close, continuous
│   ├── handshake/                          client and server handshake data and builders
│   ├── interfaces/                         ISSLChannel
│   ├── protocols/                          Sec-WebSocket-Protocol support
│   ├── server/                             the WebSocketServer abstract class and its SSL server factories
│   └── util/                               Base64, byte buffer, charset and thread helpers
├── src/main/java9/module-info.java         Java module descriptor
├── src/test/                               unit tests, per-issue regression tests, Autobahn tests, and test keystores
├── build.gradle                            Gradle build for the Maven Central artifact
├── pom.xml                                 Maven build for the same artifact
├── checkstyle-suppressions.xml             checkstyle configuration
├── eclipse-java-google-style.xml           editor style configuration
├── intellij-java-google-style.xml          editor style configuration
├── sonar-project.properties                sonar configuration
├── CHANGELOG.md                            change history
├── LICENSE                                 MIT license, per the README
├── README.markdown                         the project README
└── .gitignore                              git ignore rules
